name: kubepug
description: Kubernetes API deprecation checker that scans clusters and manifests for removed APIs before upgrades

install_steps: Download the kubepug release tarball for your platform from https://github.com/kubepug/kubepug/releases and extract the kubepug binary to PATH
Or as a kubectl plugin: kubectl krew install deprecations (invoked as kubectl deprecations)

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install kubepug: Download the kubepug release tarball for your platform from https://github.com/kubepug/kubepug/releases and extract the kubepug binary to PATH

commands.description: Scan the current kubeconfig context for deprecated/removed APIs (kubepug --k8s-version=v1.30 --format json). Reads live cluster state

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install kubepug: Download the kubepug release tarball for your platform from https://github.com/kubepug/kubepug/releases and extract the kubepug binary to PATH

commands.description: Scan local manifest files for deprecated APIs (kubepug file --input-dir ./manifests). Works offline, no cluster needed
